learning_outcomes.text: Recognize and understand the basic methodologies of linear algebra; geometry; differential geometry; differential and integral calculus; differential and partial differential equations; numerical methods; numerical algorithms; statistics, and optimization that are applied to engineering
Solve, through the use of mathematics and statistics, the possible problems that may arise in engineering
Recognize and understand the training needs that will be useful to successfully solve new situations related to industrial engineering.
Propose creative solutions to satisfactorily respond to real needs and problems of society.
Develop professional texts and scientific-technical reports according to the conventions of the field of industrial technical engineering
Adapt the organization of content and the use of language, verbal and non-verbal, to argue in various situations or before various audiences
Apply the knowledge of industrial engineering in learning new methods and theories
Show the advantages and opportunities of different solutions to the same problem critically and constructively
Apply the principles and methods of quality

syllabus_topics: Topic 2.- Numerical Resolution of Linear Equation Systems
Topic 3.- Numerical Resolution of Differential Equations
Numerical methods for solving ordinary differential equations: initial and boundary value problems.
Numerical solution of partial differential equations.
Topic 4.- Introduction to the Finite Element Method
Applications of the Finite Element Method: Deformation of beams and plates. Linear elasticity problems. Acoustics problems. Thermal problems.
teaching_methods: Problem/exercise solving in the ordinary classroom

assessment_methods.method: Delivery of practical work report (computer lab practices)

assessment_rules: Students who do not participate in any of the assessment tests will receive a score of zero for that test, which will be considered for the calculation of the average grade. Once the date for a partial written test is set, it will be unchangeable, and students who do not attend will receive a zero in it.
